# Global Saham Login Page - Detailed UI Description


## **Overall Layout & Background**
- **Background**: Gradient from soft cream (top) to light green (bottom), creating a clean, professional feel.  
- **Page Structure**: Vertical, mobile-optimized layout (portrait orientation) with a centered white container (rounded corners) holding all UI elements.  
- **Top Navigation Bar**: Fixed at the top of the page, spanning the width of the container.  


## **Top Navigation Bar**
- **Left Side**:  
  - **Logo**: Circular icon (white background) with a stylized green/white design (likely a globe or abstract symbol).  
  - **Text**:  
    - "GLOBAL SAHAM" (bold, dark green, uppercase, ~16px).  
    - "GS CAPITAL ACCESS" (smaller, gray, uppercase, ~12px, below the main logo text).  
- **Right Side**:  
  - **Button**: "Daftar" (white background, dark green text, rounded corners, ~14px, medium padding).  


## **Main Content Container (White Rounded Box)**
The container is divided into two sections: a **green header** (top) and a **white login form** (bottom).  


### **Green Header Section**
- **Background**: Solid dark green (#006633 or similar).  
- **Top Bar**:  
  - Left: "GS LIVE" (white text, small, with a lightning bolt icon).  
  - Right: A long, gray, rounded search bar (placeholder text not visible).  
- **Logo**: Circular white icon (centered) with the same stylized design as the top navigation logo, plus "GLOBAL SAHAM" text below it.  
- **Headline**: "Masuk Investor Global Saham" (white, bold, ~24px, centered).  
- **Subheadline**: "Akses akun Global Saham untuk memantau portofolio, pergerakan saham, aktivitas profit, dan layanan Investor." (white, regular, ~14px, centered, line height ~1.5).  
- **Feature Icons (3 Columns)**:  
  - **Market**: Icon (line graph), text "Market" (white, bold, ~14px), subtext "Live" (white, small, ~12px).  
  - **125K++**: Icon (users), text "125K++" (white, bold, ~14px), subtext "Pengguna" (white, small, ~12px).  
  - **Portofolio**: Icon (folder), text "Portofolio" (white, bold, ~14px), subtext "Akses" (white, small, ~12px).  
- **Graph**: A yellow line graph (wavy) on a green background, indicating market trends.  


### **White Login Form Section**
- **Input Fields**:  
  - **WhatsApp Number**:  
    - Label: "NOMOR WHATSAPP" (gray, small, ~12px, left-aligned).  
    - Input: Pre-filled with "+62 812345678901" (gray text, ~16px).  
    - Icon: Green circular icon with a white phone symbol (left of input).  
  - **Password**:  
    - Label: "KATA SANDI" (gray, small, ~12px, left-aligned).  
    - Input: Placeholder "Masukkan kata sandi" (gray text, ~16px).  
    - Icon: Green circular icon with a white lock symbol (left of input).  
    - "Lihat" Button: Small, white background, gray text, rounded corners (right of input, ~12px).  
- **Remember Me & Forgot Password**:  
  - **Checkbox**: "Ingat akun" (gray text, ~12px, left of checkbox).  
  - **Link**: "Lupa sandi?" (orange text, ~12px, right-aligned).  
- **Login Button**:  
  - Text: "MASUK SEKARANG" (white, bold, ~16px).  
  - Icon: Right arrow (white).  
  - Background: Gradient from dark green (left) to light green (right), rounded corners, medium padding.  
- **Sign-Up Prompt**:  
  - Text: "Belum punya akun? Daftar Global Saham" (gray, ~14px, centered).  
  - "Daftar" Link: Green text, bold, ~14px (clickable).  


### **Footer Section (Bottom of Container)**
- **Legal Info**:  
  - "Legalitas Perusahaan" (dark green, bold, ~14px).  
  - "Halaman resmi Global Saham" (gray, small, ~12px).  
- **Icons**: Two small icons (likely social media or app store links, e.g., Google Play/App Store).  
- **Bottom Links (3 Columns)**:  
  - "Investasi Aman" (gray, ~12px, centered).  
  - "Market Live" (gray, ~12px, centered).  
  - "125K++ Pengguna" (gray, ~12px, centered).  


## **Colors Summary**
- **Primary Green**: Dark green (#006633) for headers, buttons, and icons.  
- **Secondary Green**: Light green for the login button gradient.  
- **Text**: White (headers), dark green (brand name), gray (labels/placeholder), orange (forgot password link).  
- **Background**: Cream (page) and white (container).  


## **All UI Elements Listed**
1. Top navigation logo (circular, white/green).  
2. "GLOBAL SAHAM" text (top nav).  
3. "GS CAPITAL ACCESS" text (top nav).  
4. "Daftar" button (top nav).  
5. "GS LIVE" text (header top bar).  
6. Search bar (header top bar).  
7. Header logo (circular, white).  
8. "Masuk Investor Global Saham" headline.  
9. Subheadline text.  
10. "Market" icon + text.  
11. "Live" subtext.  
12. "125K++" icon + text.  
13. "Pengguna" subtext.  
14. "Portofolio" icon + text.  
15. "Akses" subtext.  
16. Yellow line graph.  
17. "NOMOR WHATSAPP" label.  
18. WhatsApp input field (+62 812345678901).  
19. Phone icon (green).  
20. "KATA SANDI" label.  
21. Password input field (placeholder).  
22. Lock icon (green).  
23. "Lihat" button.  
24. "Ingat akun" checkbox.  
25. "Lupa sandi?" link.  
26. "MASUK SEKARANG" button (with arrow icon).  
27. "Belum punya akun?" text.  
28. "Daftar Global Saham" link.  
29. "Legalitas Perusahaan" text.  
30. "Halaman resmi Global Saham" text.  
31. Footer icons (2).  
32. "Investasi Aman" link.  
33. "Market Live" link.  
34. "125K++ Pengguna" link.  


This layout is designed for mobile users, with clear visual hierarchy, brand consistency (green/white), and intuitive navigation for logging in or signing up. The green color scheme reinforces trust and professionalism, typical of financial/investment platforms.
